baseline.label: Current baseline
baseline.note: Plain sticky track with overscroll clamping. Earlier changes improved desktop motion, but slow dragging and settling still need comparison across devices and inputs.

native.label: 1 · Native scrolling
native.note: Fixed-width cards move in normal flow. Swipe to compare browser scrolling with the masked baseline. This control has no custom mouse dragging or changing masks.

rounded.label: 2 · Rounded clock
rounded.note: Use the arrow buttons. This deliberately rounds the custom animation’s paint input to whole CSS pixels. Finger swipes use the unchanged baseline path.

touch-handoff.label: 3 · Touch handoff
touch-handoff.note: Native finger dragging hands release to the fractional MD3 animation clock. It can still jump or rubber-band because native scrolling may continue. This is an experiment, not a completed fix.

original.label: Original · native smooth scrolling
original.note: Original implementation: native smooth scrolling for controls, scroll-driven mask geometry, and queued frame updates. Stuttering was reported on desktop and iOS. Compare slow dragging, release and arrow buttons.

first-token.label: Token clock · first implementation
first-token.note: Introduces MD3-timed custom settling and translateX positioning. Native offsets are still written during each custom animation frame. Touch release remains native.

handoff.label: One visual clock · explicit artwork positioning
handoff.note: Removes per-frame native scroll writes from custom settling and positions artwork with explicit fractional coordinates. Desktop behavior improved, while touch jitter and settling problems remained.

isolation.label: Overscroll clamp · layout hints
isolation.note: Clamps native offsets at the boundaries and adds layout containment/compositing hints. This addressed reported directional jitter, not the remaining settling stutter.

diagnostic.label: Fixed masks · diagnostic
diagnostic.note: Freezes mask widths and artwork offsets while keeping positional updates. Gaps and overlaps are expected. It did not resolve the reported stutter; this is a confounded diagnostic, not a finished layout.
